about.title: About D'Angelo's Pizzeria – Authentic Italian in the Bronx
about.subtitle: Family Tradition Since 2004
about.content:
Welcome to D'Angelo's Pizzeria and Restaurant, a beloved counter-serve pizzeria in The Bronx serving authentic Italian favorites since 2004. Located in the heart of Gun Hill, we specialize in hand-tossed pizzas made with premium mozzarella, San Marzano tomatoes, and cherished family recipes passed down through generations.

Our extensive menu features more than just pizza – enjoy fresh pasta dishes, classic Italian heroes, savory veal entrees, and rotating daily specials. Every dish is crafted with the finest ingredients and authentic Italian cooking techniques that have made us a neighborhood favorite for over 20 years.

Whether you're dining in at our casual counter-serve location, grabbing takeout on the go, or enjoying delivery to your home in The Bronx, D'Angelo's brings the warmth and tradition of a true family-run Italian eatery to your table. Experience authentic Italian cuisine in Gun Hill – where quality ingredients meet time-honored recipes. Mangia bene!
